title: መስቀል ብርሃነ
reason: Both the Ge’ez opening and Amharic restatement repeatedly name the Cross as the hymn's subject.
lyric_evidence: መስቀል ብርሃነ ለኩሉ ዓለም መሠረተ ቤተክርስቲያን | መስቀል ብርሃን ነው ለምናምን ሰዎች

title: ደስ ይበለን
reason: Most stanzas celebrate God's mercy and urge praise. Mary appears near the close as intercessor, not the main addressee.
lyric_evidence: አምላክ አለ መሀላችን | አመስግኑ ዝምም አትበሉ

title: አደባባይ ቆሜ
reason: After narrating Christ's suffering, the singer repeatedly examines hollow worship and asks to obey in love. The moral appeal is the dominant purpose.
lyric_evidence: መጀመሪያ ልቤ ከፊትህ ይንበርከክ | ስራ ከሌበት ለእኔ አይጠቅመኝ

title: Bemn Inmeslat Dingil Maryam
reason: The speaker directly addresses a woman through traditional Marian images; 'sister of angels' is a description, not an angel as subject.
lyric_evidence: የሙሴ ጽላት ነሽ የምሕረት ቃል ኪዳን | የመላዕክት አኅት የርኅሩኃን ርግብ

title: ኃያል ነው እግዚአብሔር ኃያል ነው ቅዱሱ(2)
reason: Across the opening, middle, and close the song praises God's power over storm, creation, and judgment; Tabor is one image, not proof of a feast occasion.
lyric_evidence: እርሱ ነው ጌታ የምናመልከው | ስልጣን የእርሱ ነው አለቅነት
